data.gender_notes: Faunia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In ancient Roman religion, Faunia was the goddess of fruit trees and gardens. Her name is derived from Faunus, the Roman god of agriculture, fertility, and prophecy. As a female name, Faunia represents a connection to the divine, creativity, and nurturing. The name Faunia carries the meaning “Dweller among the gods” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Faunia usually hope their child will grow to embody dweller among the gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
